assumptions.statement: Official redline, key-area polygons, regulatory controls (FAR/height/density), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All area/metric conclusions are provisional and must be recalculated after official boundary release; all land use and renewal statements are conceptual suggestions, not statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Logo, typeface, imagery and naming system are original conceptual directions; font and image copyright clearance is required before formal publication.
assumptions.impact: Brand assets are conceptual only; unauthorized fonts, images, trademarks or portraits are not used in this submission.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection controls (e.g. Qinghuayuan station), green-line and blue-line constraints, and traffic safety requirements follow official approvals.
assumptions.impact: Landmark and public-space proposals near heritage sites are conceptual; final controls follow official review.
